alternatives_considered: Agent recommendation: the same, plus judgement from credible people as periodic evidence (Direction D as calibration).
Mainly AI-designed sessions, with projects occasionally (Direction A-led).
Assembled existing products (C), human-anchored (D-led) or two venues (E).
patch.decision: Learning happens mainly through real, private projects where economics, AI and policy meet. The AI maintains a user-owned graph of capabilities with the evidence for each, and each session chooses which part to build, maintain or test. Evidence comes from AI assessment and self-assessment; judgement from other people is not a required evidence source.
patch.question: Which broad direction should the idea converge on (WI-015)?
